name: Lanesurf
long_description:
Over a million loads move via trucks in the US every day and even in 2026 they are still booked through endless negotiations over calls and emails.

Lanesurf solves this with an army of AI agents that find nearby empty trucks, call/email them in parallel, negotiate rates, and book the best available truck.

Live Demo: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7394069447327555584/

Our self-improving voice AI stack is built for the messy reality of logistics - noisy calls, compliance checks, constant exceptions and turns them into faster bookings at better margins.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Pratham studied engineering at IIT Delhi, where he contributed to ML research at Caltech and Rice. He then deployed AI systems for F500 enterprises at Booz & Co

He then built a 10x faster (than SOTA) inference application for compute-heavy ML models, that was sold to an NVIDIA-backed Bay Area company. 

At IIT, he also led Rendezvous, Asia’s largest cultural festival, drawing 150,000 attendees with sponsors including Coca Cola, Binance, and the NBA.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
Sarthak studied engineering at IIT Delhi. As an undergrad, he co-authored research on transformer-based ML models before LLMs were mainstream, with groups at University of Waterloo and Monash.

He later built a 10x faster (than SOTA) inference application for compute-heavy ML models, pioneering an algorithm that was adopted by a Fortune 100 biopharma's research arm. 

His work on computational protein design at iGEM, an MIT research initiative, was awarded Gold amongst 3000+ teams globally.
